chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Khalid ibn Najeeh, I have transmitted from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAbdullah ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Khālid ibn Najeeh al-Jawwān.

key_terms.الْجَوَّانِ: A distinguishing attribution for Khālid ibn Najeeh.
key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: A familial or tribal attribution identifying ʿAbdullah ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplicatory honorific meaning: may Allah be pleased with him.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Khālid ibn Najeeh in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Khālid ibn Najeeh. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission in hadith literature and clarifying the source chain used in the book.
